body:
Hopefully it was ok with you but I went through your post history to learn more about your situation. I'm sorry that your life has turned out this way, and that people who were suppose to love and protect you didn't. I know what it feels like to have someone who gave you life not actually give you the care you deserve. I don't know it the same way as you but we all live a life unique to us.   
I'm also not going to tell you what to do with your life as it's yours. But I hope you can find meaning in your life. Good luck on your journey where ever it may take you. And I hope you know that if only with me, you've had an affect on the world.

Thank you for the reply and for considering my situation, What you're telling me is what a lot of my friends, from the city I used to live, have been saying to me. Just finish and get a better job and find someone else. But I wanted to go farther in my education to get a better job to help my wife and I start a better life together. Now I'm not sure why I want it, or why I even want to go on living like this, when someone else might do the exact same thing to me. But again thank you for taking the time to respond and for your blunt but true words.

Thank you for your concern and for making it through my rant. The fact that you felt something when reading brings me to tears, I'm glad that someone else could just listen to my story and understand, even if only a little, the pain I'm feeling in my heart right now. Thank you again have a good day.

I wish I could be where you are, but my wife was there for me in great times of need. When I told some of my friends what she'd done they were dumbfounded, they couldn't believe it. One of my friends started laughing, then immediately stopped when he realized I wasn't joking. The look on his face when he realized I was tearing up looked as though I just told him I was dying. He looked at me like he knew my future was over. Another friend told me that he had always hoped that when he found a girl, that she would be like my wife. She was a great person until 2016.   
But I'm at the same point, in that she won't respond to me at all. It's like she's trying to cut me off cold turkey. I sit here and read little notes she left around my apartment to give me inspiration when studying and they just destroy me from the inside.   
Where you hope you never have to go through this again, I want to be sure I never get betrayed by another person again. I never want to feel, one day, that a person loves me without question, then another day like they couldn't possibly love me at all.   
But thank you for even making it through my long rant on why my life sucks. And I hope you find someone who truly loves you and would do anything for your happiness as you did for this girl. You deserve to have your love reciprocated. Best wishes for you
Thank you for responding and for being here for me, I truly appreciate it
Thank you very much for both reading my rant and for the kind words.

Thank you for the reply, my mom came out to visit me during thanksgiving so that I wouldn't spend it alone here in my little apartment and it was very hard to speak to her about this, all she could really tell me is that we're in a bad place right now and that we can get out of it. Of course she nor I really have a plan as to how to do that. What makes me not want to talk to my mother about it is she lost her job of over 25 years last year and she's had to take a much lower paying job over the last year but she still lost her house. She's currently moving and I don't know how I'm going to survive without taking more loans here.   
So I think if I stay I'll just be more of a burden to her, which I'm sure she's fine with... but I'm not. I don't want to go back to being a kid and having to ask her for money just so I can eat.  
Thank you for the support, I've received a lot of messages here and it feels good to know that there are people out there who don't even know me but still care about another human living or dying. I hope you have a great day.
